title: SEO Settings
description: Complete guide to SEO settings for improving your store's search engine visibility and organic traffic.
content:
SEO Settings

Search Engine Optimization (SEO) helps your store rank higher in search results and attract organic traffic. Configure these settings to maximize your visibility.

General SEO Settings

Access SEO settings from Store Settings → SEO:

  • Site Title: Your store's title
  • Tagline: Brief description
  • Meta Description: Default description for search engines
  • Keywords: Relevant keywords

URL Structure

Configure URL settings for SEO:

  • Product URL format
  • Category URL format
  • Blog post URL format
  • Custom page URLs
  • URL slugs

Meta Tags

Configure meta tags:

  • Default meta title
  • Default meta description
  • Open Graph tags (for social sharing)
  • Twitter Card tags
  • Canonical URLs

Structured Data

Enable structured data (Schema.org):

  • Organization schema
  • Product schema
  • Breadcrumb schema
  • Review schema
  • FAQ schema

Robots.txt and Sitemap

Configure search engine crawling:

  • Robots.txt file
  • XML sitemap generation
  • Sitemap submission
  • Exclude pages from indexing

Page-Specific SEO

Each page has its own SEO settings:

  • Custom meta title
  • Custom meta description
  • Custom meta keywords
  • Canonical URL
  • No-index option

Product SEO

Optimize products for search:

  • Product titles
  • Product descriptions
  • Product images (alt text)
  • Product URLs
  • Product schema markup

Content Optimization

Optimize your content:

  • Use relevant keywords naturally
  • Write unique descriptions
  • Optimize images with alt text
  • Create quality content
  • Use internal linking

Technical SEO

Technical SEO settings:

  • HTTPS (automatically enabled)
  • Page speed optimization
  • Mobile responsiveness
  • XML sitemap
  • Canonical tags
  • 301 redirects

Image SEO

Optimize images for SEO:

  • Use descriptive file names
  • Add alt text to all images
  • Optimize image sizes
  • Use proper image formats
  • Add image schema markup

Local SEO

For local businesses:

  • Business address
  • Business hours
  • Local business schema
  • Google My Business integration

SEO Best Practices

  • Use relevant keywords naturally
  • Write unique, quality content
  • Optimize page titles and descriptions
  • Use proper heading structure
  • Optimize images
  • Build internal links
  • Ensure fast page load times
  • Make site mobile-friendly
  • Use HTTPS
  • Submit sitemap to search engines

Monitoring SEO

Track your SEO performance:

  • Google Search Console
  • Google Analytics
  • Monitor rankings
  • Track organic traffic
  • Review search queries
